evidence.quote: Study Formats: Full-time program in English

notes: No explicit document checklist for international applicants, no application platform, no intake dates and no stated application deadline for non-EU/foreign-qualification applicants are given on the supplied pages; the 'Curriculum' item is only a downloadable information link, not a stated required document for admission. The How to apply page and scholarship page mention Stipendium Hungaricum and self-funded routes but name no application platform or deadline for this programme.

evidence.quote: English proficiency at CEFR level B2 or above, demonstrated by Cambridge B2 First (FCE) or C1 Advanced (CAE), IELTS 5.5 or above, TOEFL iBT 4 or above.
